fact: Hgraam is a Stone Giant who speaks gravely about his apprentice.
source_quote: Hgraam spoke gravely of his apprentice, the Stone Giant the party had earlier tried to stop without killing.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam expresses grief over his apprentice's madness.
source_quote: Hgraam expresses grief over his apprentice, who was driven mad by the stones: "Yes, it was a tragedy."
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam acknowledges that the party tried to stop his apprentice rather than kill him.
source_quote: He acknowledges the party tried to stop the apprentice rather than kill him.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam has never been to the surface world and considers it myth.
source_quote: He called the surface the Dreamlands, a place so foreign to him it might as well be myth.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam does not know the path to the surface himself.
source_quote: He does not know the path himself.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam has advised the Deepking to be patient and "watch the stones."
source_quote: He has advised the Deepking to be patient and "watch the stones."
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam gave the party a polished crystal as a token of gratitude.
source_quote: The Stone Giant leader presents the party with a polished crystal as a token of gratitude before returning to his duties.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam ended the audience by telling the party it is time to leave because rocks need to be tended.
source_quote: it is time for you to leave there are rocks that need to be tended.
subject: Hgraam

fact: Daz offers condolences to Hgraam regarding his training master.
source_quote: Daz learns that the mad Stone Giant was Hgraam's apprentice and offers condolences: "Sorry for what happened to your training master. Hope you're doing okay."
subject: Daz

fact: Daz finds the giant's speech regarding the Whorlstone Tunnels comical and senseless.
source_quote: Daz finds the giant's speech comical and senseless ("This makes absolutely no sense").
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum is struck by how different Hgraam is from other giants he knew.
source_quote: Gyrgum is struck by how different this giant is from the ones he knew, who mostly bellowed and hit things (paraphrase).
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The presence of demons in the Underdark is far more widespread than previously thought.
source_quote: That presence was far more widespread than the party's scattered sightings of Demogorgon, the creation the kuo-toa worshipped, the demonic manta rays and the brawling demons at Velkynvelve had suggested.

fact: The Deepking's attempts to crush resistance have driven enemies underground where they fester.

subject: Whorlstone Tunnels instability

fact: The more the Deepking enforces control, the more evil escapes the tunnels to seize control of the city.
